final.memo:
The Company is a distressed ecommerce retailer currently attempting an operational reset to preserve liquidity [D01]. With an operating margin of -21.1% compared to positive peer margins at CarMax and AutoNation, the core business remains fundamentally uncompetitive in its current state [D03, D06].

We see no path to value creation here. The thesis relies entirely on unproven management executing a multi-year turnaround in a deteriorating used-car market where prices are falling and credit availability is tightening [D05, D07]. Without an identifiable separable asset or a catalyst to force structural change, this is simply a race between cash burn and insolvency [D05, D07].

With total consolidated debt of $1.21 billion against a market capitalization of just $121.5 million, the capital structure offers no protection for equity [D04]. We require a clear margin of safety and a defined governance route to move a board, neither of which exists here [D07]. We are passing on the opportunity.
